name: Nonprofit / church
looksLike: a site with a mission donations and volunteer information
a church site with service times and directions
an organization explaining its cause and how to help
definition: A website that explains a community organization’s mission, activities, and practical ways to participate, volunteer, attend, or give support.
goal: Help visitors understand the mission and take part.
audience: Community members, supporters, volunteers, and visitors

sections.name: Mission and welcome
sections.purpose: Explain whom the organization serves and why it exists.

sections.name: Programs and gatherings
sections.purpose: Show activities, service times, and ways to participate.

sections.name: Support and impact
sections.purpose: Explain volunteering and giving with transparent information.

sections.name: Visit and contact
sections.purpose: Provide practical access, location, and contact details.

prompts.short: Build a nonprofit site with its mission, programs, ways to help, impact, and practical visit details.
prompts.detailed: Build a nonprofit / church website for community members, supporters, volunteers, and visitors. Help visitors understand the mission and take part. Include mission and welcome, programs and gatherings, support and impact, visit and contact. Use responsive layouts, clear labels, keyboard access, and visible focus. Current times and contact details.
